title: cancellAI release artifact manifest
description: Canonical, machine-verifiable record of what a cancellAI release distributes: artifact identity/checksums, target triples, release channel, source commit, build provenance, and provider-knowledge compatibility range (E17-S01). Validated by scripts/release_manifest.py.

channel.description: docs/security/SUPPLY_CHAIN.md Release channels; binds default authority (SI-030, E17-S05).

source_sha.description: Full 40-hex git commit SHA the release was built from.

build_identity.description: Origin a user can verify independently of this file's own claims (docs/security/SUPPLY_CHAIN.md 'Users can verify origin from repository/workflow/commit').

knowledge_compatibility.description: Provider-knowledge bundle schema range this build accepts (docs/security/SUPPLY_CHAIN.md 'Knowledge updates').

artifacts.description: Every binary this release distributes, each represented exactly once (AC2). Two artifacts may share a target_triple (for example an archive and an installer for the same platform), but never a name - name is the canonical identity.

name.description: Canonical artifact name, unique within this manifest.

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of the artifact bytes.
